built_from.note: Legacy material is archived evidence. Only rules marked ACTIVE here are executable.

objective.primary: Defeat Sapporo High School by Y1 October
objective.achievement_metric: At least one win by the deadline, including a reset-assisted official branch after the first-attempt result is captured.
objective.stability_metric: Credible no-match-reset performance; reset-assisted wins never satisfy STABLE.

layer_precedence.rule: Live Ver1.42 observations override public and legacy claims on mechanics/state.
Eligibility, deadlines, committed-resource availability and explicit user constraints.
Y1 October Sapporo branch policies override legacy Y2/Y3 route policies only when supersedes is explicit.
Operational gates and scoring guidance; never promoted to game rules without evidence.

decision_log_enforcement.note: DECISION_LOG is reserved for material/irreversible decisions; ordinary FAST actions are not logged.

definitions.STABLE_WIN: A win obtained on the first match-result branch without match-result reload assistance.
definitions.RESET_ASSISTED_WIN: A win obtained only after reloading/retrying the match result; counts for achievement only, never stability.
definitions.COMPARABLE_MATCH: Same broad opponent grade band and substantially same core lineup/pitcher role, with no material ruleset change between samples.
definitions.REPEATED: At least two comparable no-reset samples unless a rule explicitly defines otherwise.
definitions.STRUCTURAL_OFFENSE_CONTACT_FAIL: REPEATED <=3-hit output or a repeated heavy-strikeout pattern against farm/benchmark-grade opponents.
definitions.STRUCTURAL_CONTROL_FAIL: At least 3 BB/HBP-equivalent control failures in each of two comparable games.
definitions.MATERIAL_DECISION: Run restart/abandonment, branch or goal change, official-tournament reload-policy use, facility demolition, primary-core replacement, or another action explicitly marked material by an ACTIVE rule.

empirical_claims.supported_statement: At least one observed special-training skill acquisition changed across SAVE/LOAD retries from the same pre-training state.
empirical_claims.not_yet_proven: All drills/skills share the same reroll behavior or probability distribution.

rules.rule: Live iOS Ver1.42 state/mechanics override conflicting public or legacy claims.
A single observation is scoped to that event; generalized claims must retain scope and sample_n and cannot establish global optimum/causality.
Every live recommendation runs FAST mode and emits controlling rule_refs plus one fallback trigger.
Run FULL checkpoint only on configured triggers; do not rescan/recompute the full model every turn.
Every new DECISION_LOG record must declare RULE_APPLIED, RULE_OVERRIDDEN, or NO_RULE according to decision_log_enforcement.
Hokkaido is the practical baseline for this run, not a claim of global fastest region.
Pitcher / がんばり屋 / initial velocity +30 is a baseline candidate, not a proven optimum; capture Creation Preview and Registered Initial separately.

Before hard-locking batting/pitching cores, capture the new-run roster; classify players CORE_DEVELOP, BRIDGE_START, FUNCTIONAL, or REPLACE_CANDIDATE. Sprint scoring excludes post-October tenure value.
If a reproducible pre-new-member save point exists, test 2-3 reloads to determine whether entrant identity/quality changes. Exploit only after live confirmation.

Low-level-first: apply justified special training/ability items to October core before mass match leveling when opportunity cost is favorable. Targeted skill SAVE/LOAD may be used where reroll behavior is observed/credible.

Special-training participant choice evaluates mandatory core need, low-level efficiency, drill fit/current ability, growth, affinity bonus, and Y1-October lineup contribution. Affinity is material but not absolute. Post-October tenure is excluded.
Cheer ON is for high-value committed development; Cheer OFF is allowed for drill progression/resource preservation. ON is not assumed to raise skill-roll probability.
If STRUCTURAL_OFFENSE_CONTACT_FAIL, prioritize batting/contact even if slugging was the default.
If STRUCTURAL_OFFENSE_CONVERSION_FAIL, prioritize slugging and high-impact batting skills.
When scoring is adequate for the current gate, stop marginal hitter training and return to valuable matches.
If STRUCTURAL_CONTROL_FAIL, prioritize control/shadow.

If control is acceptable but repeated hard contact/run allowance persists, evaluate velocity/available run-prevention skills. Breaking-ball investment is conditional on actual pre-October unlock and observed K/contact need, not assumed available.
If pitching keeps the relevant grade winnable while offense binds, stop marginal pitching investment and move resources to offense.
Maintain high match density only against opponents the team can reliably beat; do not use a fixed matches-per-month target as an optimum.
After a loss/draw to a new benchmark, interleave farm/development before retest. Two equivalent failures under the same method require a method change before a third meaningful retest.
If farm choices are otherwise equal, a full 6-inning win may be preferred over mercy for point yield; keep experimental until live verified.
Practice matches used as combat gates are not match-result reloaded.

For route-critical official matches, preserve the first-attempt result as stability evidence. Subsequent reload attempts may pursue the achievement goal, but every reset-assisted win remains UNSTABLE and cannot satisfy stability gates. No arbitrary one-reload cap is imposed.

Use ability items early on low-level October core when marginal gain is valuable; use recovery items when they unlock an otherwise blocked high-value action. Treat observed item deltas as samples, not constants.
School activities are resource conversion; do not spend scarce Sports solely for measurement. Re-read random rewards after each activity.
Facility count is not pre-fixed. Field demolition/expansion requires observed replacement value or throughput bottleneck and must be logged with rule basis.
Y1 September prefectural advancement/title is route-critical and Y1 October Sapporo defeat is the terminal sprint goal; an October regional loss is not acceptable as branch success.
Monthly combat gates are operational heuristics, not game rules; no reset-assisted match may satisfy a stability gate.
Every material UNKNOWN must state interim default handling and resolve_by evidence/action; unresolved conflicts cannot be silently guessed.
Legacy Study30 reserve for December principal timing is not an active constraint in the Y1-October sprint.

Before applying screenshot/user reports, extract only visible or explicitly stated observations with source locator, period, and accepted/rejected branch. Missing fields remain UNKNOWN; corrections reference the original event. Never infer game state from earlier screenshots. After a game/resource mutation, a later SCREEN must identify the preceding mutation via after_event_id. A screenshot without visible values must not be filled from older screenshots.

Derive current state from ordered live events. A schedule is not a completed match. Explicit user completion closes that period's scheduled matches even when scores are UNKNOWN. Preserve first-attempt branches separately from reset-assisted accepted branches. Invalidate stale resource counters after a later match or rollback. Known SAVE rollback removes discarded branch contributions from the active timeline; unknown save anchor remains blocked pending recapture. Retain rejected attempts as audit-only evidence. Only committed per-player special-training events contribute to observed training counts.

Before issuing an actionable recommendation, use the latest live event revision, ACTIVE rule IDs, and validated match/resource constraints. Reject actions targeting already completed matches and paid training when resource counters are stale or insufficient. TRAIN with Cheer ON requires explicitly checked Sports and Cheer costs; older-month target matches are never upcoming. ITEM actions must fail closed until inventory availability is verified.

live_observation_contract.rollback_semantics: known restore_to_event_id discards subsequent active branch effects; unknown anchor blocks actions until evidenced recapture
live_observation_contract.fresh_screen_after_mutation: after_event_id must match last resource-invalidating event
live_observation_contract.training_counts_scope: recorded committed participants only; historical unrecorded training UNKNOWN
live_observation_contract.supported_item_actions: BLOCKED until a source-verified item inventory is modeled
